resume: Eight-voice wavetable synth: 15 table banks, seven voice architectures, two layers with splits, a four-line sequencer, a chord arpeggiator, reverbs and delays. At startup, the HOME screen is in SINGL mode (one layer, eight voices) and the keyboard plays.

commandes.role: With HOME held, focuses layer 1. With SAVE held, copies what SAVE would save. On SEQ, held + a white key, sets the line's loop start.
With HOME held, focuses layer 2 (refused in SINGL). With SAVE held, pastes. On SEQ, held + a white key, sets the line's loop end.
Oscillator pages: OSC1, OSC2, OSCMIX (and ATTACK with the STRIKE architecture). Another press goes to the next page.
Envelope pages ENV1, ENV2, ENV3. ENV1 is tied to the amp.
Pages LFO1, LFO2, LFO3. LFO1 is common to all voices, LFO2 and LFO3 run per voice.
Three modulation slots, MOD1 to MOD3, each combining two sources.
Pages AMP (amplifier, drive, sends) and EFFECTS (reverb and delay).
Pages LAYER, ZONES, PERF and GLOBAL. Held with OCT- or OCT+, changes layer.
Opens saving for what the page contains (layer patch, performance, sequence or arp pattern). The button blinks. A second press confirms. Held with OCT-, copies. With OCT+, pastes.
Four-line sequencer page, 16 steps per line. Another press goes to the next line.
Starts and stops the sequencer on the SEQ page and the arpeggiator on the ARP page. On other pages, starts both or stops whichever is playing.
Arms recording on the SEQ and ARP pages.
Steps through the page's rows: a full-screen list opens and closes 1.5 seconds after the last click.
Loads the next or previous preset, depending on the page: layer patch on the sound pages, performance on HOME, arp pattern on ARP, sequence slot on SEQ.
Changes the value of the chosen row. On the save page, chooses the slot, then NO or YES to overwrite.
Play the focused layer. On ARP, the 13 lowest keys are the chord keys and the next 8 white keys are the steps. On SEQ, the 16 lowest white keys are the line's steps.

gestes: HOME held + OCT- or OCT+: layer 1 or layer 2 (HOME acts on release).
SAVE held + OCT-: copy. SAVE held + OCT+: paste.
SEQ: OCT- held + a white key sets the loop start, OCT+ held + a white key sets the end.
ARP: hold a step key and press a chord key to store the chord in the step.
To save: SAVE, choose the slot with ALGORITHM or knob 2, name with knobs 3 and 4, SAVE again.

modes.texte: PERF MODE, on HOME, switches from SINGL (one layer) to DUAL (two layers, each on its own MIDI channel; the keys play the chosen layer) or SPLIT (the two layers share the keyboard; the ZONES page sets SPLIT NOTE, SPLIT FADE, VEL SPLIT and VEL FADE). Layer 2 does not exist in SINGL.

Four lines of 16 steps, each with its own event type, speed, direction and loop. Knobs 1 to 4 set four steps. A white key brings that step and the next three onto the knobs. In step recording, press REC then play: the note is written into each NOTE line. Keys held together form a chord of at most four notes. SCALE locks a NOTE line to a scale.

Patterns of at most 8 steps. Holding a chord key plays live. The knobs are RATE, OCTAVE, STYLE and RHYTHM. The black keys among the steps are LATCH, TIE, CLEAR, COPY and ACCENT. With REC armed, a chord key is written into the nearest step.

Four kinds: patch, sequence, arp pattern and performance (mode, global settings, two patches and the linked patterns). The SAMHAIN factory bank contains 9 performances and 32 patches. At power-on, performance 0, CAIRN SPIRIT, plays: PLAY starts its chords and bass. HOME's PERF page shows the links and changes patch, sequence or arp.

a_savoir: The FX button opens the oscillators here, not the effects: the effects are under GLO.
The wavetables and PCM waves are written to flash by the firmware installer. Without them, some PCM waves stay silent and FOUNDATIONS plays a sine.
Carnac is in beta (0.9.x). To restore the original firmware, the repository cites OCT- and OCT+ held for 5 seconds.
